data.title: A gate on the model
data.goal: Ask for a route and compare a model with the actual entrance.

memoryNodes.cue: What was here before the garden?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 花园规划之前，这里是什么？
memoryNodes.location: Beside the old map and the model of the square.

memoryNodes.cue: Where is the gate in the model?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 模型中的大门在什么位置？
memoryNodes.location: At the model gate, beside the wooden posts facing the road.
memoryNodes.locationZh: 模型门旁，朝向道路的木柱边。

memoryNodes.location: At the real entrance, beside the van and the narrow gap.
memoryNodes.locationZh: 实际入口处，货车与窄缝旁。

data.situation: An old map rested beside a small model of a downtown square. On the map, Lin followed a blue line to the bus stop. This site had once been part of a private estate, the note said. Now the plan showed a circular garden. Thin wooden posts stood around its edge, with a gate facing the road. On paper, arriving looked simple. At the real bus stop, Lin asked a worker, "Which way is the entrance?" He pointed across the square. A delivery van stood beside the gate, leaving a narrow gap. Lin waited while a parent tried to get through with a pram. The parent turned back. The model had shown an open path, but it had not shown the van. Lin wrote a question in her notebook: would this entrance work when people needed it? Before asking for a change, she wanted to check the other side.
data.zhSupport: 先看旧地图，再看模型木柱，最后看实际通道。estate 此处指土地；posts 此处是柱杆。路线询问与现场比较是原创学习任务，不是原教材例句。

glossary.note: downtown 在此修饰 square；原词项保留市中心的这一用法。

glossary.zh: 一处私有庄园的一部分
glossary.note: estate 在本课是土地；不是售房中介，也不是本文未谈及的遗产义。
本句指形状，不是循环过程。
向现场人员询问方向；也可问 Which way should I go?
get through 在此指穿过狭窄通道；不要套用完成工作这一义。
本课形容词，修饰square，说明城市中心区域的位置；不把这里的定语用法当成go downtown的副词用法。
本课土地名词，旧地图说明广场用地曾是一处私有庄园的一部分；不采用遗产总额义，也不把estate agent整块当作这个词的同义表达。
本课土地或场地名词，指广场所在的实际地点，也可迁移到新图书馆场地；不选网站名词或选址动词。
本课形状形容词，描述花园轮廓。原R01121还列循环的中文，但圆桌例句支持圆形义；不把花园形状当成循环过程。
本课名词复数，木制柱杆立在花园边缘；单数是post。不是职位、网上帖子或邮寄动作，任务不要求罗列这些无关义。
本课地点名词，指可进入花园的位置；可以由一扇gate提供入口，但两词侧重点不同。不是进场行为或使人着迷的动词。

glossary.zh: 围墙或栅栏上可开关的门
glossary.note: 本课实体门名词，模型中门朝向道路；entrance说明入口位置，gate说明可开关的门。原故事未提供门的尺寸，不擅自补尺寸。
到达公交站后用which way询问目的地的方向；is后填地点名称。本课是原创问路句型，来源entrance记录只支持入口名词。

glossary.zh: 说明计划与现场之间的差别
glossary.note: but连接模型呈现与现场观察的反差；报告具体障碍，不从一次堵塞推断入口在任何时段都不可用。复用已有but对照构式。
matchTexts: The path is open on the model, but the van leaves a narrow gap at the entrance.

glossary.zh: 通过具体行动核实是否……
glossary.note: to check whether说明实地核验的目的；whether后写需要检查的真实问题，不照搬广场货车到新图书馆。复用已有行动与核实目的构式。
matchTexts: I will visit the site to check whether a parent can get through with a pram.

glossary.note: 本课运送货物的车辆，停在入口旁形成障碍；复用现有车辆义，不用先锋群体、铁路货车或露营车义。

retrievalPrompts.cue: You have arrived at the bus stop. Ask a worker how to find the entrance.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Ask a short question that the worker can answer by pointing.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你到了公交站。向现场工作人员询问入口往哪边走。
checks: 提出可让工作人员指方向的短问句。
不要求把gate、posts等词全部放入问句。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 先完成问路目的。Which way is the entrance?已足够；来源只支持entrance的入口名词义。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Your friend has only the model. Explain where its gate is.
acceptableAnswers: The gate faces the road, beside the wooden posts.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Use a position that your friend can find on the model.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 朋友只有模型。说明模型中的门在哪里。
checks: 位置说明清楚即可，不强迫补写花园形状。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 用模型中可辨认的道路与木柱定位；门是实体，入口是进入的位置。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell the planner what the model missed and why it matters to a parent.
acceptableAnswers: The model shows an open path, but a van leaves a narrow gap. A parent cannot get through with a pram.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Link an observed obstacle to a person who needs access.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 告诉规划人员模型遗漏了什么，以及它为何影响推婴儿车的家长。
checks: 比较模型的畅通通道与现场货车造成的窄缝。
说明家长推婴儿车无法通过。
不把货车障碍直接说成花园本身的形状问题。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 观察到的障碍与受影响的人连起来；不由一次到访断定此入口永久不可用。

transferPrompt.cue: A new library has a wide entrance on its plan. Suggest one check before it opens.
acceptableAnswers: I would visit the site and check whether a parent can get through with a pram.
transferPrompt.feedback: Move the check to a new place; do not assume the library has the same van.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 新图书馆的图纸显示入口宽。建议开放前检查一项实际通行情况。
checks: 给出能否推婴儿车通过等具体问题。
不假定图书馆门旁也停着同一辆货车。
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 迁移“图纸之外还需现场核实”的行为。地点和可能障碍按新情境调整。

data.easySummary: Lin looks at an old map and a model of a downtown square. The model shows a gate beside wooden posts. At the real entrance, a van leaves a narrow gap. A parent cannot get through with a pram. Lin wants to check the other side before asking for a change.
data.easySummaryZh: 林看一张旧地图和一个市中心广场模型。模型上，门在木柱旁。实际入口处，一辆货车留下窄缝。一位家长推着婴儿车无法通过。林想先看看另一侧，再提出改动。
